title: Which Stardew Valley Villager Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover which Stardew Valley villager matches your personality!

questions.text: On a rainy day in the valley, you decide to...

options.text: Stay indoors by the fireplace, reading a book and sipping hot cocoa while listening to the rain
Head to the Saloon to join the locals for a game of pool and chat about the latest valley gossip
Sketch out plans for a new, whimsical garden layout that no one else in the valley has tried before
Spend the afternoon organizing your tool shed and repairing any broken farming equipment

questions.text: When a new farmer arrives in town, you...

options.text: Bring them a basket of fresh homegrown produce and offer to show them around the valley
Analyze their farm layout from afar and note which crops would thrive best in their soil
Invite them to the next community potluck to help them meet everyone quickly
Leave a small, thoughtful gift on their porch without drawing attention to yourself

questions.text: If your farm’s crops are threatened by a sudden storm, you...

options.text: Grab your tarp and rush to cover as many plants as possible, acting on instinct to save what you can
Follow your pre-made emergency plan, moving potted plants to the barn and securing the fence line systematically
Worry about how this will impact the valley’s food supply and check on your neighbors’ farms to offer help
Calculate the potential financial loss and start researching drought-resistant crops to plant next season

questions.text: During the Flower Dance, you choose to...

options.text: Dance with a different partner each song, making sure to greet every villager at the event
Find a quiet spot under the oak tree to watch the dancers and observe the valley’s interactions
Help set up the decorations beforehand and stay late to clean up once the dance ends
Write a poem about the beauty of the dance and share it with one close friend afterward

questions.text: When you find a mysterious artifact in the mines, you...

options.text: Take it to Gunther to identify its history and donate it to the museum for everyone to enjoy
Research its potential market value and sell it to the highest bidder in the valley
Keep it on your nightstand and make up stories about its origins before going to sleep
Use it as a paperweight on your desk since it’s sturdy and serves a practical purpose

questions.text: Your friend is upset because their farm failed. You...

options.text: Sit with them and let them vent, offering hugs and reassurance that they’ll bounce back
Help them create a detailed recovery plan, listing steps to rebuild their farm one task at a time
Bring over fresh baked goods and suggest taking a day off to go fishing and forget their troubles
Offer to lend them your extra tools and seeds, scheduling specific times to help them plant new crops

questions.text: On a quiet evening, you prefer to...

options.text: Host a small dinner party with your closest valley friends, cooking a meal together and sharing stories
Explore the secret woods at dusk, hoping to find rare mushrooms or spot a magical creature
Finish organizing your farm’s inventory, making sure every seed and tool is in its proper place
Do some stargazing alone on your roof, making wishes on shooting stars and wondering about life beyond the valley

questions.text: When planning a community event, you...

options.text: Brainstorm unique themes like a harvest festival masquerade to make the event memorable
Focus on logistics: confirming food vendors, setting up seating, and creating a timeline for the day
Let the group vote on every detail, making sure everyone’s ideas are heard and included
Take charge and delegate tasks to ensure everything runs efficiently, even if it means making tough decisions

questions.text: You find a lost puppy wandering near your farm. You...

options.text: Post flyers around town and ask every villager if they recognize the puppy
Bring it home, build a cozy bed for it, and keep it until you find its owner or decide to adopt it
Create a detailed care schedule, including feeding times and vet visits, to keep the puppy healthy
Let the puppy roam freely around the farm, trusting it to find its way home while leaving out food and water

questions.text: When you have extra gold to spend, you...

options.text: Buy a new, high-quality watering can that will make your farming tasks faster and easier
Invest in a rare, exotic fruit tree that will add a unique touch to your orchard
Treat your friends to a meal at the Saloon and buy drinks for everyone at the bar
Save it for a rainy day, knowing you might need it for unexpected farm repairs or emergencies

questions.text: You’re asked to teach a workshop in the valley. You choose to teach...

options.text: How to forage for wild edibles and use them to cook traditional valley recipes
How to paint landscapes using natural pigments made from valley flowers and berries
How to resolve conflicts between villagers using active listening and empathy
How to budget farm expenses and maximize profits from crop sales

questions.text: When the valley faces a shortage of resources, you...

options.text: Organize a community swap meet where villagers can trade tools, seeds, and food to share what they have
Stay up all night experimenting with new farming techniques to grow crops in limited space
Stick to your existing routine, conserving your own resources and focusing on maintaining your farm
Go with the flow, helping neighbors when asked but not taking on any extra responsibilities

results.title: Lewis (ESTJ)
results.description: You're Lewis, Pelican Town's dependable mayor. Like him, you prioritize structure and community harmony, always working behind the scenes to keep the valley running smoothly. You’re practical, organized, and take pride in upholding tradition. When the valley faces challenges, you step up with clear plans to resolve them, earning the trust and respect of everyone around you. You’re an ESTJ—responsible, traditional, and deeply committed to your community.

results.title: Penny (ESFJ)
results.description: You're Penny, the kind-hearted tutor of Pelican Town. Like her, you find joy in nurturing others’ growth, whether it’s teaching the valley’s kids or helping a neighbor learn to read. You’re warm, empathetic, and always put others’ needs before your own. You thrive in cozy, intimate settings where you can connect deeply with people. You’re an ESFJ—compassionate, nurturing, and dedicated to lifting those around you up.

results.title: Shane (ISFJ)
results.description: You're Shane, the quiet but loyal ranch hand. Like him, you show your care through small, consistent gestures—fixing a neighbor’s fence without being asked, or leaving fresh eggs on a friend’s porch. You’re practical, reliable, and deeply loyal to those you let into your inner circle. You prefer to stay out of the spotlight but are always there when someone needs you. You’re an ISFJ—devoted, humble, and steadfast in your support for others.

results.title: Maru (ISTJ)
results.description: You're Maru, the brilliant inventor of Pelican Town. Like her, you’re analytical, organized, and obsessed with solving complex problems. You spend hours in your workshop tinkering with machines, always looking for ways to make life in the valley more efficient. You’re practical and logical, preferring to rely on facts and data rather than emotions. You’re an ISTJ—detail-oriented, disciplined, and driven by a desire to create useful, functional things.

results.title: Abigail (ESTP)
results.description: You're Abigail, the adventurous rebel of Pelican Town. Like her, you love taking risks and exploring the unknown—whether it’s diving into the mines or sneaking out to dance in the rain. You’re spontaneous, bold, and always up for a new challenge. You hate feeling stuck in routine and thrive on excitement. You’re an ESTP—energetic, daring, and unafraid to break the rules to have fun.

results.title: Samantha (ESFP)
results.description: You're Samantha, the lively bartender of the Stardrop Saloon. Like her, you’re the life of every party, with a contagious laugh and a knack for making everyone feel welcome. You love being around people and thrive in social settings. You’re spontaneous and fun-loving, always looking for the next good time. You’re an ESFP—outgoing, playful, and gifted at bringing joy to those around you.

results.title: Elliott (ISFP)
results.description: You're Elliott, the romantic writer of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re creative, introspective, and deeply connected to nature. You spend hours by the ocean, writing poetry and admiring the beauty of the valley. You’re gentle and sensitive, preferring quiet moments of reflection over loud social events. You’re an ISFP—artistic, soulful, and driven by a love for beauty and authenticity.

results.title: Harvey (ISTP)
results.description: You're Harvey, the calm and collected doctor of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re practical, logical, and skilled at staying calm under pressure. You excel at solving problems quickly, whether it’s fixing a broken radio or treating a sick villager. You’re quiet and reserved, preferring to work alone but always ready to help when needed. You’re an ISTP—resourceful, level-headed, and skilled at using your hands to fix almost anything.

results.title: Alex (ENFJ)
results.description: You're Alex, the ambitious athlete of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re charismatic, motivated, and passionate about helping others reach their goals. You’re a natural leader, with a talent for inspiring those around you to be their best selves. You’re warm and empathetic, always looking for ways to lift others up. You’re an ENFJ—charismatic, encouraging, and driven by a desire to make a positive impact on the valley.

results.title: Haley (ENTJ)
results.description: You're Haley, the confident fashion enthusiast of Pelican Town. Like her, you’re bold, determined, and unafraid to speak your mind. You have a clear vision for what you want, whether it’s creating a stylish outfit or organizing a successful community event. You’re a natural leader, with a talent for getting things done. You’re an ENTJ—assertive, strategic, and always one step ahead of the game.

results.title: Sebastian (INFJ)
results.description: You're Sebastian, the mysterious programmer of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re introspective, creative, and deeply passionate about your work. You spend hours in your basement coding or playing video games, lost in your own world of ideas. You’re quiet and reserved, but you form deep, meaningful connections with the few people you let into your life. You’re an INFJ—intuitive, idealistic, and driven by a desire to create something that matters.

results.title: Leah (INTJ)
results.description: You're Leah, the talented artist of Pelican Town. Like her, you’re independent, creative, and driven by a clear vision of what you want to achieve. You spend hours in your cabin painting or sculpting, focused on bringing your unique ideas to life. You’re logical and strategic, preferring to work alone and follow your own path. You’re an INTJ—innovative, determined, and unapologetically true to your artistic vision.

results.title: Sam (ENFP)
results.description: You're Sam, the upbeat musician of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re energetic, creative, and full of big ideas. You love playing music with your friends and dreaming up new ways to entertain the valley. You’re optimistic and enthusiastic, always looking for the silver lining in every situation. You’re an ENFP—imaginative, passionate, and determined to make the valley a more fun and vibrant place.

results.title: Emily (ENTP)
results.description: You're Emily, the quirky clothing designer of Pelican Town. Like her, you’re creative, unconventional, and always coming up with new, wild ideas. You love experimenting with different styles and fabrics, creating unique outfits that reflect your personality. You’re playful and curious, always looking for ways to shake up the valley’s routine. You’re an ENTP—innovative, witty, and unafraid to challenge the status quo.

results.title: Jas (INFP)
results.description: You're Jas, the sweet and imaginative young villager of Pelican Town. Like her, you’re gentle, creative, and full of wonder. You love spending time with animals, drawing pictures, and making up stories about the valley’s magical creatures. You’re sensitive and empathetic, always caring deeply about the feelings of others. You’re an INFP—dreamy, compassionate, and driven by a love for all things beautiful and kind.

results.title: Vincent (INTP)
results.description: You're Vincent, the curious and intelligent young villager of Pelican Town. Like him, you’re analytical, creative, and always asking questions about how things work. You love exploring the mines, collecting rocks, and learning about the valley’s history. You’re quiet and introspective, preferring to spend time alone with your thoughts rather than in large groups. You’re an INTP—logical, curious, and driven by a desire to understand the world around you.
